description: Claude Code harness behaviors, tool interactions, and orchestration gotchas

entries.bad_pattern: Launching a Workflow (or write-heavy subagents) while the session is still in plan mode
entries.good_pattern: Confirm ExitPlanMode succeeded (plan actually approved) before launching any Workflow/agents that write files; if a plan-approval response contains instructions instead of plain approval, treat plan mode as still active
entries.description: Plan mode propagates to all Workflow subagents: every agent runs read-only, so porting/wiring agents silently write their output into ~/.claude/plans/*-agent-*.md draft files instead of the repo, and verification agents cannot run builds or dev servers. The workflow "completes" but produces zero repo changes — costing a full multi-agent run. This happened on 2026-06-10: an ExitPlanMode call was rejected (user reply contained extra instructions), plan mode stayed active, and a 14-agent Phase-1 workflow ran entirely in plan mode. Recovery: re-call ExitPlanMode, then re-launch agents instructed to materialize from the draft plan files.
entries.context: Claude Code sessions using EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode together with the Workflow or Agent tools
